note: Basic customs duty on gold raised from 4% to 6%, one of three hikes inside eight months during the 2013 current-account-deficit crisis. Press sources give month-level precision only ("January 2013") — exact day not verified, dated to the 1st of the month as a placeholder.
source: Business Standard / ThePrint 2013 duty-hike retrospectives (cross-referenced, month-level precision only)

note: Basic customs duty on gold raised from 6% to 8%, second of three 2013 crisis-era hikes. Month-level precision only ("June 2013") — exact day not verified.
source: Business Standard / ThePrint 2013 duty-hike retrospectives (cross-referenced, month-level precision only)

note: Basic customs duty on gold raised from 8% to 10%, third of three 2013 crisis-era hikes; duty then held at 10% through 2014-2018. Month-level precision only ("August 2013") — exact day not verified.
source: Business Standard / ThePrint 2013 duty-hike retrospectives (cross-referenced, month-level precision only)

note: Union Budget 2019-20 (announced 2019-07-05, effective 2019-07-06): basic customs duty on gold bar and gold doré raised from 10% to 12.5%.
source: World Gold Council, Gold Focus, 2019-07 ("India's gold import duties rise")

note: Union Budget 2021-22, effective 2021-02-02: basic customs duty on gold bar cut from 12.5% to 7.5%, with a new 2.5% Agriculture Infrastructure Development Cess (AIDC) introduced alongside it and a Social Welfare Surcharge exemption. Net total consumer tax (incl. GST) fell from 16.26% to 14.07%, a 2.19pp cut -- magnitude_pct here is that total-tax delta, not the BCD-only delta (BCD itself fell 5pp, largely offset by the new AIDC).
source: World Gold Council, Gold Focus, 2021-02 ("India's gold import duties reduced")

note: Effective 2022-07-01: basic customs duty on gold bar raised from 7.5% to 12.5% (gold doré 6.9% to 11.85%); AIDC unchanged at 2.5%; Social Welfare Surcharge (10% of BCD) exempted. Total consumer tax rose from 14.07% to 18.45%, a 4.38pp increase -- magnitude_pct here is that total-tax delta.
source: World Gold Council, Gold Focus, 2022-07 ("India's gold import duties hiked")

note: Union Budget 2024-25: total customs duty on gold cut from 15% to 6%, the sharpest reduction on record and the lowest since June 2013. A World Gold Council regional CEO put the total-tax-incl-GST effect at roughly 18.5% to 9%, a ~9.5pp cut -- magnitude_pct here uses that total-tax framing for consistency with the 2021/2022 entries above (previously null in this file; filled 2026-09-23 after sourcing).
source: World Gold Council, Gold Focus, 2024-07/2024-08 ("Indian gold import duties reduced to the lowest level in over a decade"); Business Standard, Union Budget 2024 coverage

note: Effective 2026-05-13: basic customs duty on gold, silver and platinum raised from 5% to 10%, taking the effective total import duty on gold and silver from ~6% to ~15% -- the steepest single increase on record, driven by rupee depreciation and a push to curb non-essential imports amid a sharp rise in bullion purchases (gold imports +81.7% YoY, silver +157.2% YoY per the government's May 2026 Monthly Economic Review).
